caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate jug positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The jug has a wide, rounded body with a narrow base, a short neck that widens at the mouth, a pronounced spout, and a large curved handle connecting the upper neck to the shoulder of the vessel. The handle features a floral motif near the top. The mouth of the jug is decorated with a patterned border incorporating geometric and floral designs in muted tones of gray, blue, and white. The main body of the jug is adorned with detailed botanical designs, including large flowers and leaves rendered in shades of gray, blue, and light brown. The entire jug has a subdued and slightly metallic appearance, with subtle highlights and shadows indicating its three-dimensional form. The background remains unadorned, focusing all attention on the central vessel.
title: Pewter Creamer
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
